blockers.detail: flashopen1.js checkflash fails on Chrome without NPAPI/PPAPI Flash → #swfdiv replaced by iframe#flash22 blockflashtip; no #flashgame/#flashgame1 left for Ruffle to upgrade
4399 health system modal requires login before play; observed 2026-10-11 ~22:15

Game page HTML/JS has no setHold/Hold literals (confirmed in 4399-205551_4.htm + five footer JS). Hold is injected by 4399 container calling timeline.setHold(hold) after SWF load — that container path is Flash-era player chrome, not present when only Ruffle polyfills the embed

Local probe 2026-10-12: Ruffle loads main.swf on 127.0.0.1 but ruffle-player.setHold === undefined. timeline.setHold is an AS3 MovieClip property from ǵ.installTimelineHooks, not ExternalInterface.addCallback — JS cannot call it through Ruffle's public EI surface

hypothetical_if_ruffle_extension_interce.reason: Even with SWF playing under Ruffle, nobody calls setHold; ServiceHold stays isReady=false / hold=null — same as offline empty path, NOT an online Hold instance fingerprint

conclusion: Ruffle+4399 cannot deliver ONLINE-HOLD-FINGERPRINT.json. Reopen needs native Flash (or 4399 environment that both loads SWF and performs container setHold).
